assets.name: Attack
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production mobile game UI sprite, transparent PNG.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the previously approved mobile controls mockup. Do not reproduce the screenshot.
Primary request: ONE isolated ATTACK BUTTON matching the lower-right folding-fan attack button in the reference.
Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas, one perfectly round button centered at (512,512), outer diameter approximately 880px, even transparent padding on all four sides. Orthographic flat front view. The complete circle and its narrow shadow must fit inside the canvas.
Style: Korean fantasy ink-painted HUD. Deep dark teal-black circular inset with subtle ink-wash grain, TWO slim concentric antique warm-gold rim lines, a very small amount of restrained Korean cloud-scroll ornament on the rim at lower-left and lower-right. Low relief, calm matte finish; no bulky machinery, no ornate medallion jewelry. Gold color around #D5AF62, dark inset #142B30.
Central symbol: a large open Korean folding paper fan, crisp ivory paper segments and thin dark bamboo ribs, downward facing small ivory pivot. Strong readable silhouette. Icon fully inside the disc, centered, occupying about 55 percent of its diameter. Keep symbol completely legible at 96 pixels.
Transparency: alpha transparent outside the circular button; no checkerboard pixels, no scene, no rectangular backing, no background color. Retain a dark readable interior. Do not bake game environment into button.
Constraints: NO text of any language, NO letters or numbers, NO caption, NO screen, NO other buttons, NO grid, NO watermark. Only one completed normal-state button. Clean anti-aliased silhouette. Output 1024x1024 pixels at most.

assets.prompt:

Keep the same dark teal-black ink-wash circular inset, two antique warm-gold rims, front-facing flat view, small lower-side gold cloud ornaments and transparent padded square canvas. Match reference palette and ornament, ensure direction markers remain readable when the sprite is displayed at 140px.

assets.name: JoystickKnob
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated movable JADE JOYSTICK THUMB KNOB sprite for a Korean fantasy mobile action game. The reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: reproduce JUST the small jade-green center knob from the bottom-left movement control, not the rest of the screenshot and not the outer joystick pad.
Create ONE simple round polished jade disc, flat front-facing view, soft low-relief domed center, restrained mottled translucent teal-jade stone, subtle ivory-jade highlight on upper-left, thin pale jade edge ring, narrow deep dark-teal rim behind the jade. Calm painted game UI appearance, clear clean circle silhouette. No antique-gold outer joystick frame, no arrows, no fan, no glyph, no text, no ornaments, no lettering. This is the small moving thumb control component, not the full joystick base.
Centered alone on a 512x512-pixel square canvas, approximately 448px diameter, equal transparent padding on every side. The small jade disc fills this one asset; it will be displayed smaller in-game. Transparent alpha background everywhere outside the knob, including corners, no scene, no background color or checkerboard, no cast shadow beyond a narrow contact edge. Output one PNG with transparency.
